script_text: Stop! Aquarius, the stars are not whispering—they are issuing a deadline. The real trigger is the New Moon at 24° Gemini in your 5th House of romance, creativity, and children, exactly squared by Saturn at 24° Pisces in your 2nd House of money, with Mars at 22° Aries in your 3rd House adding a second square. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
